data.long_meaning: Naibahat means beautiful, delightful, charming and lovely in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto and Persian. The name Naibahaat carries the meaning “Delightful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Naibahaat usually hope their child will grow to embody delightful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Naibahaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delightful, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naibahaat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: Naibahaat
in_english.meaning: assistant with good fortune and blessings
in_english.long_meaning: The name Naibahaat is derived from the Arabic root N-B-H, which means submission, obedience, and goodness. In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with a person who assists and brings good fortune to others. The name has been used in various cultures to signify the qualities of a helper and a bringer of blessings. In Arabic, the name Nā'ibāhāt (نائباحة) means 'assistant with good fortune', and in Urdu, it is written as نائباحة and means 'assistant and blessed'. In Hindi, the name is written as नाइबाहात and means 'assistant and talent'. In Pashto, the name is written as نائبهات and means 'assistant or blessed'. In Turkish, the name is written as Naibahaat and means 'assistant and honor'.
